Описание движения тела по наклонной плос: The description of the motion of a body on an inclined plane is well known. If the surface on which the body slides is not flat (curved), then on such sections the normal reaction force is not equal to the normal component of the gravitational force due to the presence of centripetal accelerations. This leads to additional losses of mechanical energy of the moving body.
